name: Stack More
summary: Drinkable potions, eggs and snowballs fit many more to a slot, so brewing sessions and chicken farms need fewer chests.
logoPrompt: A small tower of three identical glass potion bottles with pink liquid stacked neatly on top of each other, centred, in blocky voxel style

cover.tagline: More potions, eggs and snowballs per slot.

description: **Stack More lets drinkable potions, eggs and snowballs share a slot, so your inventory and chests hold more of them.**
- Drinkable potions stack up to 16, water bottles included.
- Eggs stack up to 64 instead of 16.
- Snowballs stack up to 64 instead of 16.
- Only identical potions stack: a different effect, duration, strength or name keeps its own slot.
- Drinking from a stack gives the empty bottle back; with a full inventory it drops at your feet.
Put the jar into the `mods` folder next to Fabric API. Collect and brew as usual; matching items stack by themselves in your inventory, chests and hoppers.
- Made for Fabric Loader on Minecraft: Java Edition 1.21.1 and needs Fabric API.
- Install it on the server and on every player's game. Stack sizes are not sent over the network, so a game without the mod still expects the old ones. In singleplayer your own game is enough.
- Splash and lingering potions stay at one per slot, and the brewing stand still holds one bottle per slot.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
